title: State vs. Appellant (Criminal Appeal)
query_text: Writ petition filed by a female software engineer against non-compliance with the POSH Act, 2013. The petitioner alleges continuous hostile work environment and improper handling of her complaint by the Internal Complaints Committee (ICC). The employer failed to form an unbiased ICC committee as mandated under Section 4 of the POSH Act. The petitioner seeks quashing of retaliatory termination and compensation for mental agony.

The High Court's decision to dismiss the appeal and uphold the life sentence is affirmed.
